items.name: medication-card
items.title: Medication card
items.description: One medicine: its name as given, how it is taken in the words of the national on-screen display guidelines, and its status. An order opens to its doses, including those not given and why. For a patient, plain instructions.
items.docs: The card writes a dosage from its structured parts and shows the prescriber's text as written when it cannot. It makes no clinical judgement. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: observation-table
items.title: Observation table
items.description: A flowsheet of observations: one row per series, one column per round, oldest to newest. Each value shows the band a schema gave it and its change since the value before.
items.docs: The table shows the bands it is given and makes no clinical judgement of its own: apply an observation schema from @cadence-clinical/core first. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: vitals-chart
items.title: Vitals chart
items.description: Vital signs on stacked tracks over one time axis, with the bands an observation schema gave them, span presets, Start and Latest, a Tracks menu and range modes.
items.docs: The chart shows the bands it is given and makes no clinical judgement of its own. Offer the Observation table beside it. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.
